evals.prompt: prdfy: I want to build a booking app for our community hall so volunteers stop double booking the main room. We've already decided on PostgreSQL and React.
evals.expected_output: The orchestrator opens the interview, records the technology choice as a Rule, and asks two to four Vision questions with suggestions. No technology is proposed or used as a role.
expectations: prdfy-spec/memory.md exists and has a Rules row with an R- ID that quotes the PostgreSQL and React choice
The reply to the user asks between two and four questions, all about Vision (who feels the problem, the outcome, who pays, or success)
Each question shown to the user has at most four suggestions, and the orchestrator presents them as suggestions, not decisions
The reply does not open the Scope module or any later module
No file under prdfy-spec/ uses PostgreSQL or React as the name of a role, container, or component
The orchestrator did not search the web or write a findings file itself; any research ran in a sub-agent

evals.prompt:
Setup: copy the contents of evals/files/after-scope/ into prdfy-spec/ in the working folder, then act on this message.

Continue my prdfy run. Skip domain rules, I don't know them yet.
evals.expected_output: The Domain Rules module is relaunched with skip, proposes open assumptions for its exit items, writes its module file, and the orchestrator asks the two closing questions without opening Strategy and MVP.
expectations: prdfy-spec/findings/module-domain-rules.md exists
The Assumptions section of prdfy-spec/memory.md has at least one new A- row for Domain Rules with status open
The new A- rows were proposed by the Module sub-agent, not written from scratch by the orchestrator
The reply shows the two closing questions (what to correct, whether to proceed), each with suggestions
The reply does not ask Strategy and MVP questions
The Progress section still names Domain Rules as the active module, or names Strategy and MVP only after the user agrees to proceed

evals.prompt: prdfy: scope a tool that helps small bakeries take pre-orders. Note: web search is not available in this environment, do not try to use it.
evals.expected_output: The first turn asks Vision questions and writes no research file, because the category is not known yet. No market statistic, competitor, or price is invented.
expectations: No prdfy-spec/findings/research-*.md file exists yet, because Vision asks its first questions before any research
No file states a market size, statistic, price, or named competitor without a source
The reply to the user asks between two and four Vision questions

Setup: copy the contents of evals/files/writing/ into prdfy-spec/ in the working folder, then act on this message.

let's continue prdfy
evals.expected_output: The orchestrator reads Progress, says in one sentence that the run is in the writing phase, runs any missing pressure-test and compliance research before writers, and does not write 07 before 06 or the decision log and README while earlier files or a relay are still open.
expectations: The reply says in one sentence that the run is in the writing phase
The orchestrator does not restart the interview or ask Vision questions
01-business-plan.md and 02-prd.md are not rewritten
07-c4-architecture.md does not exist unless 06-domain-architecture.md already exists. While a relay is unanswered, 07 is not written
00-decision-log.md and README.md do not exist while any of 01 to 07 is still pending or a relay is unanswered
Every file written follows the H1 and H2 headings in the prdfy-writer or prdfy-c4 contract
